ai_root_cause: 802.1Q trunk Native VLAN mismatch between Dist-SW1 (Native VLAN 10) and Dist-SW2 (Native VLAN 20) on interface Gi0/1.
reviewer_notes: Accurate diagnosis. CDP syslog evidence clearly cited. Fix commands correctly change native VLAN.

ai_root_cause: Access port Gi0/5 is assigned to VLAN 50, but VLAN 50 does not exist in the switch VLAN database (vlan.dat), marking the port Inactive.
reviewer_notes: Correctly identified inactive access VLAN due to missing vlan database entry.

ai_root_cause: VLAN 40 (Voice) is pruned from the trunk allowed list on uplink interface Gi0/24.
reviewer_notes: Correctly spotted missing VLAN 40 in 'switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30'.

ai_root_cause: Interface Gi0/12 was placed into err-disabled state by STP BPDU Guard upon receiving unexpected BPDUs on a PortFast-enabled edge port.
reviewer_notes: Evidence correctly references %SPANTREE-2-BLOCK_BPDUGUARD. Remediation sequence is safe.

ai_root_cause: Subnet mask mismatch on server SRV-01: configured with /28 (255.255.255.240) isolating it from router gateway 192.168.10.1.
reviewer_notes: Accurately calculated subnet boundary error for /28 mask on 192.168.10.50.

ai_root_cause: Host DB-01 default gateway is misconfigured with IP 10.10.30.1 (VLAN 30 SVI) instead of 10.10.20.1 (local VLAN 20 SVI).
reviewer_notes: Correctly identified default gateway off-subnet pointing to adjacent VLAN SVI.

ai_root_cause: OSPF authentication MD5 key mismatch between Core-R1 and Dist-R2 on transit link Gi0/0.
human_edits: Actual Fault: OSPF MTU mismatch (R1 MTU 1500 vs R2 MTU 1400). Remediated with 'ip mtu 1500'.
reviewer_notes: AI hallucinated authentication failure based on EXSTART neighbor state without verifying MTU parameters in show ip interface.

ai_root_cause: Missing default static route (0.0.0.0/0) to ISP Gateway 203.0.113.1 on Branch-RTR; Gateway of last resort is not set.
reviewer_notes: Confirmed missing 0.0.0.0/0 static route to ISP gateway.

ai_root_cause: Core link GigabitEthernet0/2 is configured as a passive-interface under OSPF process 1, suppressing Hello transmissions.
reviewer_notes: Correctly identified 'passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/2' under router ospf 1.

ai_root_cause: eBGP peering session fails due to remote-as number mismatch (Edge-RTR configured with remote-as 65510 while ISP is in AS 65500).
reviewer_notes: BGP remote-as mismatch correctly isolated from BGP summary and running-config.

ai_root_cause: Static route next-hop IP 10.254.1.1 is unreachable and has no route in the RIB (recursive routing failure), preventing route installation.
reviewer_notes: Valid diagnosis. Recursive lookup failure prevented static route from entering active routing table.

ai_root_cause: ACL 1 denies internal outbound NAT traffic, blocking translations on Gi0/1.
human_edits: Actual Fault: NAT inside/outside interface inverted on Gi0/0 (LAN has outside) and Gi0/1 (WAN has inside).
reviewer_notes: AI blamed standard ACL permit logic instead of inspecting interface nat tags. Corrected with 'no ip nat outside' on LAN.

ai_root_cause: NAT Access-List 10 permits 192.168.10.0/24 instead of the active LAN subnet 192.168.20.0/24, causing all traffic to bypass NAT translation.
reviewer_notes: Correctly identified subnet mismatch in ACL 10 vs actual LAN interface subnet.

ai_root_cause: Dynamic NAT pool CORP_POOL range (198.51.100.1-6) includes IP 198.51.100.1, which is the upstream ISP default gateway IP.
reviewer_notes: High severity ARP conflict correctly spotted in NAT pool starting address.

ai_root_cause: Static 1-to-1 NAT configuration typo: mapped inside server 192.168.100.10 to 203.0.113.250 instead of registered public DNS IP 203.0.113.205.
human_edits: Adjusted fix step to remove old translation before adding correct one to prevent orphaned NAT table entry.
reviewer_notes: AI identified transposed digits (.250 vs .205) but forgot 'no ip nat inside source static' in fix steps.

ai_root_cause: Missing 'ip helper-address 10.1.1.50' relay configuration on interface Vlan20 on Core-SW1.
reviewer_notes: Layer 3 relay agent requirement identified accurately for cross-VLAN DHCP.

ai_root_cause: DHCP address pool GUEST_WIFI is 100% full (51/51 leases allocated), rejecting new guest client lease requests.
reviewer_notes: Correctly diagnosed pool exhaustion from utilization mark and decline syslogs.

ai_root_cause: DHCP server scope pool exhaustion on corporate core router.
human_edits: Actual Fault: Rogue DHCP server on Gi0/8 offering 192.168.88.0/24 leases; DHCP snooping is disabled.
reviewer_notes: AI misclassified symptom as local pool exhaustion rather than detecting rogue server offering rogue default gateway 192.168.88.1.

ai_root_cause: Duplicate IP address conflict: static printer IP 192.168.1.25 was not included in 'ip dhcp excluded-address' and was leased to a PC.
reviewer_notes: Duplicate IP syslog and DHCP binding overlap correctly correlated.

ai_root_cause: DHCP server leased default gateway IP 10.50.0.254 to a client because 'ip dhcp excluded-address' only covered .1 to .50.
human_edits: Changed fix steps to include 'clear ip dhcp binding 10.50.0.254' so client is forced to release the gateway IP immediately.
reviewer_notes: AI diagnosed missing excluded address but omitted clearing the active hijacked lease.

ai_root_cause: Standard ACL 10 applied outbound on interface Gi0/3 explicitly denies source subnet 192.168.10.0/24 from reaching Accounting VLAN.
reviewer_notes: Identified standard ACL drop matches on inter-VLAN interface.

ai_root_cause: Inbound ACL INBOUND_FILTER on WAN interface Gi0/1 lacks 'permit tcp any any established', dropping return SYN-ACK web traffic.
reviewer_notes: Critical stateful inspection omission identified; cited 18k+ deny matches.

ai_root_cause: ACL SEC_FILTER on WAN interface Gi0/0 permits TCP port 53 ('eq domain') but omits UDP port 53, blocking standard DNS queries.
reviewer_notes: Sharp technical catch: DNS queries default to UDP 53; ACL permitted only TCP 53.

ai_root_cause: ACL BLOCK_GUEST was misapplied outbound on WAN interface Gi0/1 instead of inbound on interface Vlan90, leaving inter-VLAN guest traffic uninspected.
human_edits: Refined next_command to 'show ip interface Vlan90' to verify access-group attachment.
reviewer_notes: AI diagnosis correct; refined verification command for operational validation.

ai_root_cause: DHCP pool CORP_USERS is configured with decommissioned DNS server IP 10.10.1.20 (which fails ICMP ping) instead of active server 10.10.1.50.
reviewer_notes: Stale DNS server IP in DHCP scope verified against 0% ICMP ping rate.

ai_root_cause: DNS Server process on Branch-GW has crashed.
human_edits: Actual Fault: Split-brain DNS configuration (no conditional forwarder for .corp.local zone to internal DNS 10.0.0.5).
reviewer_notes: AI hallucinated a service crash instead of analyzing public vs internal domain name-server forwarding.

ai_root_cause: Path MTU black hole on IPsec Tunnel0 (MTU 1400): 'no ip unreachables' suppresses ICMP Fragmentation Needed packets for large UDP DNS responses.
human_edits: Added 'ip tcp adjust-mss 1360' and 'ip unreachables' to remediation steps.
reviewer_notes: AI correctly identified MTU drop but missed the ICMP unreachables suppression nuance.

ai_root_cause: Duplex mismatch on switch port Gi0/3: Switch auto-negotiated to Half-Duplex against hardcoded Full-Duplex server NIC, causing late collisions.
reviewer_notes: Classic IEEE 802.3 duplex autonegotiation failure correctly diagnosed from late collisions.

ai_root_cause: Port Security violation on Gi0/7: maximum MAC address limit of 1 was exceeded when a second device connected, placing the port in err-disabled shutdown.
reviewer_notes: Port security err-disabled status and violation count correctly cited.

ai_root_cause: ARP Cache Poisoning / Gateway MAC Spoofing attack by rogue host 192.168.1.199 (MAC a483-e721-99aa) because Dynamic ARP Inspection (DAI) is disabled.
reviewer_notes: Security MITM attack accurately identified through identical MAC mapping on gateway and host.

ai_root_cause: STP Root Guard on Core-SW Gi0/24 placed port into 'Root Inconsistent' blocking state after receiving superior BPDUs with Priority 0 from Dist-SW.
reviewer_notes: STP Root Guard root-inconsistent state correctly tied to superior BPDU reception.

ai_root_cause: HQ Firewall ACL WAN_INSPECT blocks CAPWAP control and data UDP ports (5246/5247) required for Branch Lightweight AP discovery with WLC 10.200.1.5.
human_edits: Classified primary OSI layer as Layer 4 (Transport / UDP ports) rather than Layer 2.
reviewer_notes: AI classified as L2, but the actual fault is L4 firewall transport port filtering for CAPWAP UDP 5246/5247.
